verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents that idle Turso databases scale to zero or stop incurring cost. What it does show is adjacent: a Free tier with 11-nines durability (turso-docs-45) and a community user who stayed on the free tier (turso-comm-2). A free pricing plan is not the same as scale-to-zero, and "cold start times are basically zero" describes latency, not idle billing. None of this earns credit for this story.

support.subject: As a founder, idle databases scale to zero so prototypes and side projects cost nothing while the data stays durable
